title: A public-goods game restarts
hook: Two stated cases: explore the contribution level after a stated restart.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the contribution level after a stated restart affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Payoff, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the contribution level after a stated restart in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
